8204926.en: {relation|A|B}, you must have more important matters since you have made a Breakthrough. Can you spar with me today and give me pointers?
8204926.ch: {relation|A|B}，你既已突破想必也无要事了。今日能否与我切磋一番，指点我在战斗中的不足？

8204929.en: {call|B|A}, you reached {grade|A}. I need to train in cultivation to catch up to you! Let's not do Dual Cultivation today but have a spar instead, okay?
8204929.ch: {call|B|A}，你已{grade|A}了，我也要刻苦修炼一番赶上你！今日就不双修了，我们来切磋一番可好？

8204930.en: {call|B|A}, you reached Breakthrough to {grade|A}. How about sparring with me today?
8204930.ch: {call|B|A}，你已突破到{grade|A}了，今日不如来与我切磋一番可好？

8204933.en: Ah, I should not have challenged your might as {grade|A}! This {0} is my most treasured item, please accept it and spare my life...
8204933.ch: 果然我不该贸然挑战你这{grade|A}的大能！这里的{0}是我最珍贵的东西，还请在收下后饶我一条性命…

8204934.en: Ah, I should not have challenged your might as {grade|A}! This {1} is my most treasured item, please accept it and spare my life...
8204934.ch: 果然我不该贸然挑战你这{grade|A}的大能！这里的{1}是我最珍贵的东西，还请在收下后饶我一条性命…

8204935.en: The might of {grade|A} sure is great... I'll get going then.
8204935.ch: {grade|A}的大能，果然有气度…那么我先走了。

8204936.en: {grade|A} is truly impressive! It's your win.

8204937.en: {call|B|A}, you've become even more amazing after Breakthrough to {grade|A}!

8204938.en: {relation|A|B}, you've become more powerful after Breakthrough to {grade|A}! I lost.
8204938.ch: {relation|A|B}，你突破到{grade|A}后果然更厉害了！我输了。

8204939.en: Disciple, you've become more powerful after Breakthrough to {grade|A}! As expected of my Disciple!
8204939.ch: 徒儿，你突破到{grade|A}后果然更厉害了！不愧是我的弟子啊！

8204940.en: Master, you've become even more amazing after Breakthrough to {grade|A}! Please trade blows with me more often in the future!
8204940.ch: 师父突破到{grade|A}后果然更厉害了，以后若有闲暇，多陪我过过招吧！

8204941.en: {call|B|A}, you've become more powerful after Breakthrough to {grade|A}! As expected of my {relation|A|B}!
8204941.ch: {call|B|A}，你突破到{grade|A}后果然更厉害了！不愧是我的{relation|A|B}啊！

8204942.en: {relation|A|B} became more powerful after Breakthrough to {grade|A}! Come trade blows with me whenever you have some free time!
8204942.ch: {relation|A|B}突破到{grade|A}后果然更厉害了！以后若有闲暇，多陪我过过招吧！

8204943.en: {call|B|A}, you've become more powerful after Breakthrough to {grade|A}! As expected of the one I approve of!
8204943.ch: {call|B|A}，你突破到{grade|A}后果然更厉害了！！不愧是我看上的人！

8204946.en: It was just a fluke! But {call|B|A}, you've become more powerful after Breakthrough to {grade|A}!
8204946.ch: 侥幸罢了！不过，{call|B|A}，你突破到{grade|A}也变得更厉害了！

8204947.en: So what if you reached Breakthrough to {grade|A}? I still won! Do you yield, {call|B|A}?
8204947.ch: 突破到{grade|A}又如何！还不是我胜了！{call|B|A}，你服是不服？！

8204948.en: I won! But {relation|A|B}, you've become more powerful too after Breakthrough to {grade|A}!
8204948.ch: 是我赢了！但{relation|A|B}你突破到{grade|A}也变得更厉害了！

8204950.en: Looks like I win this time! How's that? I didn't slack in my Cultivation! {call|B|A}, even though you just had a Breakthrough a few days ago, you need to keep working hard!
8204950.ch: 看来这次是我赢了！如何？我可是一直都没有懈怠过修炼呢！{call|B|A}，虽然你前些日刚突破了，但是你也还要继续加油呀！

8206601.en: You are in a hurry when you see a woman being chased, and she is fleeing for her life. The woman sees you and her expression changes, then she runs quickly towards you.
8206601.ch: 你正在赶路之际，突然看到前方有一女子正被人追杀，那女子看到你，神色一变，迅速向你跑来。

8206602.en: Cultivator, this person is trying to force me to do Dual Cultivation with him by taking advantage of my injury. Please save me...
8206602.ch: 道友，此人趁我受伤之际，想逼我与他双修，求你救救我……

8206701.en: This is a quarrel between Partners. I advise you to mind your own business.
8206701.ch: 我们道侣之间在吵架，劝你别多管闲事。

8206702.en: He's lying! I don't know him.
8206702.ch: 他骗人，我根本就不认识他。

8206801.en: Hmph. What kind of cretin bullies a woman?
8206801.ch: 哼，何方宵小在此欺负一女子。

8206802.en: Since you don't know your place, I shall show no mercy.
8206802.ch: 既然你不识好歹，就别怪我心狠手辣了。

8206901.en: T-Thank you for saving me, Cultivator.

8206902.en: Who are you, and why does that person want to kill you?
8206902.ch: 你是何人，那人为何追杀于你？

8207001.en: My name is {name|B} and I am a Rogue Cultivator. If I had not been fortunate enough to run into you, Cultivator, I'm afraid I would have... today, I would have...
8207001.ch: 小女子名为{name|B}，乃一介散修，今日若不是有幸遇见道友，只怕……只怕我今日就要……

8207101.en: I will repay you one day for saving my life. Please allow me to take my leave now.
8207101.ch: 道友救命之恩，来日必报，容小女子先行告退。

8207102.en: You think about it, and leave.

8207202.en: You rest in the inn for a few days and you are about to leave when you see a woman suddenly run up to you and grab your arm.
8207202.ch: 你在客栈中休息了几日，正欲离开，却见一女子突然跑到你身前抓住你的手臂。

8207301.en: Cultivator, save me! This person... This person wants to take advantage of me because I'm injured!
8207301.ch: 道友，救救我，此人……此人趁我受伤竟轻薄于我！

8207302.en: I advise you not to meddle in this, or I shall be merciless.
8207302.ch: 我劝你不要多管闲事，否则别怪我不客气。

8207401.en: I cannot turn a blind eye to the molestation of a woman in broad daylight.
8207401.ch: 光天化日之下调戏一弱女子，我岂能熟视无睹。

8207402.en: Ha! Someone wants to play hero and save the damsel in distress. Let's see if you are capable.
8207402.ch: 哟，有人想英雄救美，就看你有没有这个本事了。

8207501.en: Thank you for breaking me out of that, Cultivator.

8207502.en: Are you alone? Where is your Sect?
8207502.ch: 你是独自一人？你的师门呢？

8207601.en: My name is {name|B}, and I am a Rogue Cultivator with no Sect. This is my first time training and if it hadn't been for you, I... I wouldn't have known what to do...
8207601.ch: 小女子名为{name|B}，乃一介散修，并无师门，初次历练，此次若不是道友为我解围，我……我真不知该怎么办。

8207701.en: I will repay you one day for freeing me. Please allow me to take my leave now.
8207701.ch: 道友解围之恩，他日必报，容小女子先行告退。

8207802.en: You have just entered the market when you hear a woman shouting, "Catch the thief!" You look toward the commotion and see a man running, with a woman hot on his heels, and they are heading in your direction.
8207802.ch: 你刚进入坊市，就听到有女子大喊“抓贼”，循声望去，你看到一男一女正在前后追逐向你跑来。

8207901.en: Cultivator, help me stop that thief, quick!
8207901.ch: 道友，快帮我拦住前面那小贼。

8207902.en: Move! Get in my way and I'll make your life miserable.
8207902.ch: 滚开，敢拦我让你没好果子吃。

8208001.en: I cannot ignore theft in broad daylight.
8208001.ch: 光天化日之下行此等偷窃之事，我岂能熟视无睹。

8208002.ch: 既然你这么爱管闲事，那就去死吧。

8208101.en: T-Thank you for stopping the thief.

8208102.en: You should be careful next time.

8208201.en: Thank you for the reminder, Cultivator. My name is {name|B} and I am a Rogue Cultivator. This thief stole the Interspatial Ring that holds all my possessions. If not for you stopping the thief, I... I wouldn't have known what to do.
8208201.ch: 多谢道友提醒，小女子名为{name|B}，乃一介散修，这小贼偷走的储物戒中便是我的全部财物，若不是道友最后拦住这贼子，我……我真不知该如何是好。

8208301.en: I will repay you one day. Please allow me to take my leave now.
8208301.ch: 道友之恩，他日必报，容小女子先行告退。

8208302.en: You think about it and move aside.

8208402.en: After you defeat the beast, you discover a woman trapped in the cave. You gather your Energy and break the seal, freeing her.
8208402.ch: 你击败异兽后，在其洞府中发现有一女子被困在此处，你凝聚灵力破开禁制，将她救了出来。

8208501.en: You... You managed to defeat it!

8208502.en: Who are you? Why are you here? Could you be...
8208502.ch: 你是何人，为何在此地，莫不是……

8208601.en: Do not be mistaken, Cultivator. I... My name is {name|B} and I am a Rogue Cultivator who entered these caves by accident after getting injured. If it weren't for your great feat in defeating the evil beast, I'm afraid I would have been buried here.
8208601.ch: 道友别误会，小女……小女子名为{name|B}，乃一介散修，受伤后误入了此等龙潭虎穴，若不是道友大发神威，击杀这异兽，只怕我早晚都要葬身于此。

8208702.en: {call|B|A}, I will join your Sect one day.
8208702.ch: {call|B|A}，真想加入你的宗门，可惜我现在达不到入宗条件。

8208801.en: {call|B|A}, I cannot join your Sect now, but I will work hard.
8208801.ch: {call|B|A}，虽然我现在无法加入你的宗门，但我会努力的。

8208802.en: {call|B|A}, you can train in your new Sect and I will try to catch up to you.
8208802.ch: {call|B|A}，你且在新宗门修行，我会努力赶上你的。

8208901.en: {call|B|A}, you joined a new Sect? I want to join too, so I'll work hard.
8208901.ch: {call|B|A}，你加入新宗门啦，那我也要努力进你的宗门呢。

8208902.en: {call|B|A}, the Sect you joined looks much more powerful than mine. Wait for me for a few days, I'll come look for you.
8208902.ch: {call|B|A}，你去的新宗门看起来比我现在的宗门厉害多了，你等我几日，我便来找你。

8209001.en: {call|B|A}, I've joined {school|A} too. We are in the same Sect now!
8209001.ch: {call|B|A}，我也加入{school|A}了,现在我们可是同门了哦！

8209002.en: {call|B|A}, we agreed to train together, so you can't leave me behind. Wait for me, I'll come to the new Sect to look for you soon.
8209002.ch: {call|B|A}，咱们可是说好要一起修行，你可不能丢下我，等着哦，我很快就来新宗门找你。

8209101.en: {call|B|A}, you can't leave me by myself and go to the new Sect. I'll take care of some business and come back to look for you.
8209101.ch: {call|B|A}，你可不能丢下我一人去新宗门，待我处理些琐事，便退宗来找你。

8209102.en: {call|B|A}, I also became a disciple of {school|A} so we are in the same Sect now.
8209102.ch: {call|B|A}，我也成了{school|A}弟子,可以和你在同一个宗门了哦。

8209202.en: {call|B|A}, there is no meaning in me staying in this Sect without you in it. Wait for me in the new Sect, I will join you soon.
8209202.ch: {call|B|A}，这宗门里若没有你，我一个人呆着又有什么意思，你在新宗门等我，我很快就退宗来找你。

8209301.en: {call|B|A}, I joined {school|A} too. We will never be apart...
8209301.ch: {call|B|A}，我也加入{school|A}了,我们永远都不会分开……

8209302.en: {call|B|A}, I... I cannot join your Sect because I don't meet {school|A}'s entry requirements...
8209302.ch: {call|B|A}，因未满足{school|A}的入宗条件，我，我无法加入你的宗门……

8209401.en: Careful, come here. Let's get out of here.
8209401.ch: 小心，快来我这，我有一法子可以离开此地。

8209402.en: Thank goodness I was passing through this place, or you would have no one to seek help from.
8209402.ch: 幸好我这次游历路过此地，否则就来不及救你啦。

8209502.en: There's no need for thanks. You helped me in the past too. I... I'll get going.
8209502.ch: 说什么谢谢，你以前也帮过我呢，我……我先走了

8209601.en: You're heavily wounded. It seems this monster is powerful. Go! I'll deal with it.
8209601.ch: 你怎么重伤了，看来这妖兽着实强悍，你快走，我来对付它。

8209701.en: I will be fine. Go, now!

8209702.en: As soon as {name|B} is done speaking, magic is cast to teleport you before you can protest, and as you leave, the last thing you see is the monster pouncing at her frail form.
8209702.ch: 只见{name|B}说完，不等你开口，便施展法力将你传送走，离开之际，你看到了庞大的妖兽正扑向了她弱小的身躯。

8209801.en: Cough... We escaped, fortunately. I am heavily wounded but will be healed in a few months. Are you okay?
8209801.ch: 咳咳……幸好逃出来了，虽然重伤，但过几个月便好了，你还好吗？

8209901.en: That's good, I... I'll get going.

8209902.en: {call|B|A}, I won't let you die! What is the meaning in me living alone if you are gone...
8209902.ch: {call|B|A}，我不会让你死的，若你死了，我一个人独活又有什么意思……

8210002.en: Don't worry, I'll be okay. Leave, now!
8210002.ch: 放心，我不会有事的，你快走！

8210101.en: {name|B} casts magic to teleport you before you can protest, and as you leave, the last thing you see is the monster pouncing at her frail form.
8210101.ch: 只见{name|B}不等你说完，便施展法力将你传送走，离开之际，你看到了庞大的妖兽正扑向了她弱小的身躯。

8210102.en: Phew... It's a good thing the monster was already weakened by you or I would have been finished in there. I am heavily wounded but will heal in a few months. Are you okay?
8210102.ch: 呼……幸好那妖兽已被你消耗了一番，不然我说不定就要栽在里面了，虽说重伤，但养几个月便好，你还好吗？

8210202.en: What a relief. What's most important to me is that you are okay. I... I'll go tend to my wounds.
8210202.ch: 那我便放心了，你没事便是我最在乎的事，我……我先去养伤了。

8210301.en: Stop! If you dare kill {name|A}, you will not be able to bear the consequences.
8210301.ch: 住手，若你敢杀{name|A}，后果是你承受不住的。

8210302.en: Oh? I'd like to see what these consequences are.
8210302.ch: 哦？我倒要看看是什么样的后果。

8210401.en: The sky is suddenly filled with thick smoke, and {name|B} takes this chance to save you from there.
8210401.ch: 突然漫天的浓烟迅速弥漫，{name|B}趁着浓烟将你救了出去。

8210502.en: You helped me in the past, and today gave me a chance to help you.
8210502.ch: 当初你帮了我，今日我也有机会帮回你啦。

8210601.en: Stop! If you dare kill {name|A}, I will hunt you to the ends of the Earth.
8210601.ch: 住手，若你敢杀{name|A}，我必追杀你至天涯海角。

8210701.en: {name|A}, there are some things I've kept hidden for a long time and I wanted to tell you in a few days, but it looks like I won't get the chance...
8210701.ch: {name|A}，有些话我藏在心底许久，本想过几日对你说，如今看来，是没机会了……

8210801.en: You are heavily wounded and haven't had time to finish your sentence when you are transported away by Tao. As you leave, you see {name|B} charging towards the enemy, followed by a huge explosion that reaches high into the sky. You don't know if {name|B} survived.
8210801.ch: 重伤的你还未来得及把话说完，便被一道法力传送走，离开之际，你看到{name|B}冲向敌人，紧接着一道巨大的爆炸波直冲云霄，生死不知。

8210901.en: Cough... I'm not dead yet, don't curse me.
8210901.ch: 咳咳……我还没死呢，你瞎咒我什么。

8211001.en: Pfft, I'm just teasing. I escaped with my life but I am heavily wounded. I'm afraid it will take months for me to recuperate. Are you okay?
8211001.ch: 噗嗤，逗你呢。不过我虽然活着跑了出来，但也落得了重伤，恐怕需要数月来修养，你还好吗？

8211101.en: What a relief. Take care of yourself. I... I will go tend to my wounds.
8211101.ch: 那我便放心了，你照顾好自己，我……我先去养伤了。

8211102.en: Stop! If you dare kill {name|A}, I will never let you off.
8211102.ch: 住手，若你敢杀{name|A}，我和你不死不休。

8211201.en: Oh? How scary. Let's see what you can do then!
8211201.ch: 哦？我好怕哦，那便让我瞧瞧你的本事吧！

8211202.en: {call|B|A}, if I perish... Don't forget to bring flowers to my grave annually. I like flowers the most...
8211202.ch: {call|B|A}，如果我不幸……，别忘了每年今日多带些花来看我，我最喜欢花了……

8211501.en: You made it out alive! Thank goodness!

8211502.en: Well, I'm not dead but I'm heavily wounded. I'll need at least a few months to heal. Take care of yourself. I... I'll go tend to my wounds.
8211502.ch: 哼哼，虽说没死，但也重伤，少不得几个月的休养，你照顾好自己，我……我先去养伤了。

8211602.en: I envy you guys. In my case, I don't know when that blockhead will take the initiative to confess to me.
8211602.ch: 真羡慕你们，而我钟意的那个榆木脑袋，什么时候才会主动跟我告白呢。

8211701.en: You said these things to me in the beginning too...
8211701.ch: 这些话，你当初也这般对我说过……

8211702.en: {call|B|A}, we've spent all this time together. Why are you suddenly abandoning me...?
8211702.ch: {call|B|A}，这些时光我们都一起走过，为何突然要丢下我……

8211802.en: Never mind, this is your choice and I respect it... I will erase you from my heart and you will be a stranger when I say goodbye.
8211802.ch: 罢了，这既是你的选择，我尊重你……我会将你从我心底抹去，再见便是陌路。

8211901.en: I didn't expect you to teach that person a lesson when I was humiliated. Thank you...
8211901.ch: 当初这人那般羞辱于我，没想到你帮我教训了他，谢谢你……

8211902.en: This person is my enemy, and you even offended this person for my sake. You... You are a good person.
8211902.ch: 此人乃我仇人，你竟为我得罪此人，你……你真好。

8212001.en: {call|B|A}, this person is my enemy. I am very touched that you helped me teach him a lesson...
8212001.ch: {call|B|A}，此人乃我仇人，你能帮我教训他，我很感动……

8212002.en: What a coincidence to meet you here, {call|B|A}.

8212101.en: I didn't expect to meet you here, {call|B|A}. Have you encountered anything interesting?
8212101.ch: {call|B|A}，竟在此处和你相遇，可有遇到了什么有趣之事？

8212102.en: I haven't seen you in days, {call|B|A}. I miss you...

8212201.en: What a coincidence to meet you here, {call|B|A}...
8212201.ch: {call|B|A}，我在此地便是期待着遇到你……

8212202.en: You're here too, {call|B|A}. Are you buying something?
8212202.ch: {call|B|A}，你也来此地，可是要买些什么？

8212301.en: What a coincidence to meet you here, {call|B|A}. The town is very lively.
8212301.ch: {call|B|A}，好巧，在这里遇到了你，这座城镇还真热闹……

8212302.en: {call|B|A}, what a coincidence that you're here too.

8212401.en: {call|B|A}, there are monsters everywhere here. Be careful...

8212402.en: {call|B|A}, danger is all around here. Be more careful. I'm worried about you...
8212402.ch: {call|B|A}，此处危险，你多加小心，我担心你……

8212501.en: Bad timing. Am I bothering you guys...?
8212501.ch: 真不巧，我是不是打扰到你们了……

8212601.en: {call|B|A}, if you want to do Dual Cultivation, why not come look for me?

8212602.en: What a coincidence! You came here to look for Breakthrough material too?
8212602.ch: 好巧，你也是来这里寻找突破材料的？

8212701.en: I can't believe I ran into you here. I hope you gain something.
8212701.ch: 竟然在此地遇到你，希望你也能有所收获。

8212702.en: {call|B|A}, this place is dangerous. Did you come here specifically to look for me?
8212702.ch: {call|B|A}，此地颇为危险，你是特地来找我的吗？

8212801.en: {name|A}, this {name|C} dared to take advantage of my unpreparedness to ambush me.

8212802.en: Hmph. I will kill you today, and no one can stop me.
8212802.ch: 哼，今天我必杀了你，谁也不能阻止我。

8212902.en: Who knows who will die first? Take this!
8212902.ch: 还不知道谁先受死，出招吧！

8213001.en: {name|A}, I knew it. You'll save me for sure!

8213102.en: {name|C}, my friend {name|A} is here. You should get lost now.
8213102.ch: {name|C}，我的好友{name|A}就在此，你还不快滚

8213302.en: {name|A}! I knew it! Nobody in this world will help me, and you are the only one who will definitely save me...
8213302.ch: {name|A}，我就知道，整个八荒谁都可能不帮我，唯有你是一定会救我……

8213501.en: {call|B|A}, save me! {name|C} wants to kill me for revenge.

8213601.en: You dare touch one of my people? Die!
8213601.ch: 我的人你也敢动，受死吧。

8213701.en: {call|B|A} is my beloved indeed, and looks so charming while fighting.
8213701.ch: {call|B|A}，不愧是我的心上人，战斗的样子真迷人。

8213802.en: I heard that my {relation|C|B}{name|C} met with danger and I cannot leave it be. Take care of yourself...
8213802.ch: 听闻我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}遇到了危险，我不能见死不救，你保重……

8213901.en: {name|A}, my {relation|C|B}{name|C} is in danger and I must go to the rescue. If... If fate allows, I will see you again...
8213901.ch: {name|A}，我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}遇到了危险，我必须前去相救，若……若有缘，还会再见……

8213902.en: {call|B|A}, I heard that my {relation|C|B}{name|C} is in danger. I must go out for a period of time. Take care of yourself...
8213902.ch: {call|B|A}，听闻我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}遇到了危险，我要出门一番，你照顾好自己……

8214001.en: {call|B|A}, the martial arts now are not suitable. I search for some new ones on purpose. Let's spar sometime.
8214001.ch: {call|B|A}，现在的功法已不太适用，我特地去找寻了新的功法，有机会你我切磋一番。

8214002.en: {call|B|A}, the martial arts I am cultivating are poor and I need to cultivate a better martial art. I hope to gain something.
8214002.ch: {call|B|A}，如今我所修功法着实差劲，需要去寻找更好的功法才行，希望能有所收获。

8214101.en: {call|B|A}, I recently found that all my martial arts have failed to keep up with the Realm. If I cannot find suitable martial arts, how can I be qualified to stand by your side?
8214101.ch: {call|B|A},近日发觉所修功法已逐渐跟不上境界，希望能找到合适的功法，否则又怎有资格站在你身边。

8214102.en: I want to Breakthrough to a higher Realm but my cultivation is severely lacking. Let me cultivate quietly for a while and go a few rounds with you.
8214102.ch: 我想要突破到更高境界，但修为还差很多，待我潜心修行了一阵，便来找你讨教一番。

8214201.en: I have sensed a sliver of a chance to Breakthrough recently, but my cultivation is insufficient. Let me cultivate quietly for a while and go a few rounds with you.
8214201.ch: 我近日感到一丝突破契机，却修为不足，待我修行一番，便来找你讨教讨教。

8214202.en: {call|B|A}, I have been a little lazy recently and my cultivation is increasing slowly. I am training hard now, and I hope you do not rebuke me...
8214202.ch: {call|B|A},我近日有些偷懒，修为增长缓慢，我已经在努力修行了，希望你不会责怪我……

8214401.en: I heard that there is a Reincarnation Stone near here. If people who love each other make an everlasting promise in front of the Reincarnation Stone, they will be blessed by this stone. Would you be willing to take me there...?
8214401.ch: 听闻此处有一颗三生石，若相爱之人在三生石前约定终生，会得到此石的祝福，你愿意带我去吗……

8214501.en: You stand hand in hand in front of the Reincarnation Stone, and promise not to give up on each other in this life or the next. The Reincarnation Stone gives off a gentle glow that bathes the two of you.
8214501.ch: 你们执手站在三生石前，约定此生此世生死不弃，只见三生石上散发出一道柔和的光，轻柔地洒在你们身上。

8214502.en: I am not willing to be your {0}. This is not the relationship I want...
8214502.ch: 我不愿成为你的{0}，这不是我想要的关系……

8214601.en: We've just met. Although I have a good opinion of you, I think we need to get to know one another a little better first, okay?
8214601.ch: 我们方才认识没多久，虽然我对你好感，但再让我们彼此熟悉一些，好吗……

8214602.en: I fell in love with you the first day we met. Now, you are willing to join with me and become my Partner. I am very happy...
8214602.ch: 你我相遇的第一天，我便倾心于你，如今你愿与我结为道侣，我很欢喜……

8214702.en: {call|B|A}, I had a breakthrough to {grade|B}. I can catch up with you if I work hard!
8214702.ch: {call|B|A}，我突破到{grade|B}，虽然还没赶上你，但我会努力的！

8214801.en: {call|B|A}, I had a breakthrough to {grade|B}. Finally I've caught up with you. I will be of help to you in the future...
8214801.ch: {call|B|A}，我突破到{grade|B}，终于赶上你啦，以后我也能帮上你了呢……

8214802.en: {call|B|A}, I had a breakthrough to {grade|B}. Though outranking you, I think you are the only one that deserves the title of the number one person in the world in the future.
8214802.ch: {call|B|A}，我突破到{grade|B}，虽然比你高，但在我心里，未来只有你才配做这八荒第一人。

8214901.en: {call|B|A}, I know the beast's a tough one, but it's nothing to you!
8214901.ch: {call|B|A}，我就知道，此等异兽虽然凶狠，但对你来说又怎算难事！

8214902.en: I have {0} here for you. You may need it now. Don't decline.
8214902.ch: 我这有{0}送给你，你现在应该用得着，不准拒绝哦。

8215801.en: {call|B|A}, take Breath of Soul Formation and Soul Formation will be a piece of cake for you. Look forward to the day you reach Soul Formation. You'll impress the whole world!
8215801.ch: {call|B|A}，拿下化神之气，化神境便触手可得，真期待你化神的那一天，定会惊艳整个八荒！

8215802.en: By making a move in front of you, {name|C} of {grade|C} rank would be throwing a straw against the wind.
8215802.ch: 区区{grade|C}的{name|C}在你面前出手，只能是以卵击石。

8215901.en: {call|B|A}, it'll be a piece of cake for you to defeat {name|C} in the same realm with you!
8215901.ch: {call|B|A}，击败这同境界的{name|C}，对你来说真是轻而易举！

8215902.en: Awesome, {call|B|A}! You've defeated {name|C}, who is up a realm.
8215902.ch: {call|B|A}，你竟然越境界击败了{name|C}，实在太厉害了。

8216001.en: How dare {name|C}, who is just {grade|C}, irritate you! I've taught {gender2|C} a lesson.
8216001.ch: 那{name|C}不过{grade|C}，竟然敢触怒于你，我已经去把{gender|C}教训了一顿。

8216002.en: {name|A}, to make sure {name|C} doesn't affect your cultivation, I've taught {gender2|C} a lesson.
8216002.ch: {name|A},为了不让{name|C}影响你的修行，我去把{gender|C}教训了一顿。

8216101.en: {call|B|A}, {name|C} bullied you in the first place. Even though {gender1|C}'s realm is higher than mine, I can't let you suffer this for nothing. I'll go teach him a lesson.
8216101.ch: {call|B|A}，那{name|C}当初欺负于你，纵使{gender|C}的境界比我高，但我不能让你白白受这口气，我去教训他一顿。

8216102.en: In a lower realm than me, {name|C} looks so merry in front of me. I've got to teach {gender2|C} a good lesson to make {gender2|C} learn.
8216102.ch: 那{name|C}境界比我低，却在我面前如此跳脱，我必须好好教训{gender|C}一顿，教{gender|C}长长记性。

8216201.en: I have a score to settle with {name|C}. Today I finally get to teach {gender2|C} a lesson. What a delight!
8216201.ch: 那{name|C}与我颇有仇怨，今日终于找到机会教训了{gender|C}一顿，实在大快人心。

8216202.en: {call|B|A}, I finally defeated {name|C}. Even though this person's realm exceeds mine, so what? I am not afraid of the challenge to reach greater heights.
8216202.ch: {call|B|A}，我终于把那{name|C}打败了，纵然此人境界超过我又如何，为求念头通达，我不惧挑战。

8216301.en: In a lower realm than me, {name|C} dares to take the initiative to attack me, yet is beaten hard by me.
8216301.ch: 那{name|C}境界比我低，竟敢主动攻击我，结果被我打得遍体鳞伤，真是自讨苦吃。

8216302.en: Haha, in the same realm, {name|C} takes the initiative to attack me, yet is defeated by me. What a delight!
8216302.ch: 哈哈，那{name|C}境界与我相同，主动攻击于我却被我击败，实在是大快人心。

8216401.en: In a higher realm than me, {name|C} takes the initiative to attack me, yet is defeated by me. What a delight!
8216401.ch: 那{name|C}仗着境界比我高，主动攻击于我，却没想到我会将其击败，真是大快人心。

8216402.en: I was defeated by {name|C}, who is just {grade|C}? Am I a loser?
8216402.ch: 那{name|C}不过{grade|C}，竟然都能将我击败，我是不是很没用……

8216501.en: I was defeated by {name|C}, who is in the same realm as me. Am I so weak?
8216501.ch: 那{name|C}境界与我相同，却把我打败了，我是不是太弱了……

8216502.en: In a higher realm than me, {name|C} takes the initiative to attack me. How despicable!
8216502.ch: 那{name|C}仗着境界比我高，主动攻击于我，太可恶了！！！

8216601.en: It was close. {name|C} took advantage of my unpreparedness to sneak up on me. Although I couldn't beat him, I managed to escape to see you.
8216601.ch: 好危险，那{name|C}趁我不备竟偷袭于我，虽然我打不过他，但幸好留了个心眼，得以逃出来见你一面。

8216602.en: {name|A}, you must strive to become stronger so that unlike me, you won't have to run in the face of the attack of {name|C}.
8216602.ch: {name|A}，你要努力变强，就不会像我这般，被那{name|C}攻击却只能逃跑，任凭那人耀武扬威。

8216701.en: {call|B|A}, {name|C} tried to kill me. If I didn't run away desperately, I'm afraid you wouldn't see me anymore...
8216701.ch: {call|B|A}，那{name|C}竟然要杀我，若不是我拼命跑掉，只怕你已经看不到我了……

8216702.en: Ahhh. It was not until afterward that I found {name|C} was so detestable to steal from me!
8216702.ch: 啊啊啊啊，我事后才发现，那{name|C}着实可恶，竟然来偷我东西！

8216801.en: {name|C} stole my item and still act so righteous about it! How infuriating!
8216801.ch: 啊啊啊啊，那{name|C}偷了我的东西还理直气壮，气死我了！

8216802.en: Who gives {name|C} the guts to steal from me? Unforgivable!
8216802.ch: 那{name|C}哪来的勇气，竟然偷我的东西，此人太可恨了！

8216901.en: I am in love with you but I also expect you to treat me better. Don't make things difficult for me...
8216901.ch: 我虽衷情于你，但也期待着你能对我好一些，不要让我为难……

8216902.en: Am I really not important to you at all?
8216902.ch: 我在你眼里真的一点都不重要吗？

8217001.en: If you don't care about me, you and I will meet again as strangers.
8217001.ch: 你既对我如此不在乎，以后你我再见便是陌路。

8217002.en: {name|A}, to be able to win the Champion title in this Immortal Tournament of gathered Heaven-chosen participants makes you the true Heaven-chosen.
8217002.ch: {name|A}，能在这天骄云集的升仙大会上夺得魁首，你才是真正的天骄。

8217101.en: {call|B|A}, these Heaven-chosen are nothing special when compared to you! The future number one person in the world will definitely be you.
8217101.ch: {call|B|A}，这些天骄在你面前，不过如此！未来八荒世界第一人，必定是你。

8217102.en: {name|A}, you have become the {school|A}'s {post|A} at such a young age. You are the most powerful among your peers.
8217102.ch: {name|A}，如此年纪便当上了{school|A}的{post|A}，同辈之中你当属最强。

8217201.en: Congratulations, {call|B|A}, on becoming the {school|A}'s {post|A}. There will definitely be a place for you in the world in the future.
8217201.ch: {call|B|A}，祝贺你，成为了{school|A}的{post|A}，未来这八荒之中必有你的一席之地。

8217202.en: {call|B|A}, your becoming the {school|A}'s {post|A} has brought glory to me too.
8217202.ch: {call|B|A}，你当上这{school|A}的{post|A}，我也沾了不少光呢。

8217301.en: {name|A}, you are a sect leader at such a young age. {school|A} will flourish under your leadership.
8217301.ch: {name|A}，如此年纪便掌管一宗，{school|A}在你的带领下必将愈加兴盛。

8217302.en: Congratulations, {call|B|A}, on becoming the {school|A}'s {post|A}. Your leadership would surely take {school|A} to new heights in the future!
8217302.ch: {call|B|A}，祝贺你，成为了{school|A}的{post|A}，未来必定能带领{school|A}发展壮大！

8217401.en: {call|B|A}, your becoming the {school|A}'s {post|A} means that you will definitely stand at the top of the world one day.
8217401.ch: {call|B|A}，你当上这{school|A}的{post|A}，有朝一日必定能站在八荒之巅。

8217402.en: {name|A}, I did not expect you to be so adept at forging that you can produce an Artifact of this quality.
8217402.ch: {name|A}，想不到你的炼器水平如此厉害，竟能炼出此等品质的法宝。

8217501.en: {call|B|A}, it is truly impressive that you can forge an Artifact of this quality!
8217501.ch: {call|B|A}，此等品质的法宝竟然被你炼出，着实厉害！

8217502.en: {call|B|A}, this high Artifact quality is rare in the world. If you combine this with the Artifact Spirit, its power will be multiplied.
8217502.ch: {call|B|A}，此法宝的品质之高，世所罕见，若融合器灵，威力必将倍增。

8217601.en: That {name|C} dared to speak ill of you in front of me. How annoying.
8217601.ch: 那{name|C}竟然在我面前说你的坏话，着实讨厌。

8217602.en: {call|B|A}, no matter what bad things {name|C} or anyone else says about you, I won't believe it. You are forever the best to me.
8217602.ch: {call|B|A}，无论{name|C}还是其他人和我说你的坏话，我都不会相信，在我心里，你永远是最好的。

8217701.en: {call|B|A}, that {name|C} dared to speak ill of you in front of me, but whatever you are, you are still the person I love most.
8217701.ch: {call|B|A}，那{name|C}竟然当着我的面说你坏话，但对我来说，无论你是怎么样的，都是我最爱的人。

8217702.en: That {name|C} spoke ill of me to you?! That hateful, infuriating person!
8217702.ch: 那{name|C}竟然跟你说我的坏话，着实可恶，生气！

8217801.en: {call|B|A}, that {name|C} slandered me! You... you cannot believe {gender2|C}!
8217801.ch: {call|B|A}，那{name|C}如此诋毁我，你……你可不要信{gender|C}。

8217802.en: {call|B|A}, that {name|C} is truly vicious to drive a wedge between us. {gender|C} has no idea how much I love you.
8217802.ch: {call|B|A}，那{name|C}真是内心险恶，竟想分化我们，{gender|C}根本不知道我有多爱你。

8217901.en: No less from the {appellationNew|A}! This gracefulness bowls one over!
8217901.ch: 不愧是{appellationNew|A}，此等风采，令人折服！

8217902.en: {call|B|A}, congratulations on becoming the {appellationNew|A}! Your noble bearing is to be admired.
8217902.ch: {call|B|A}，恭喜你成为{appellationNew|A}，君之风采，令人仰慕。

8218001.en: {call|B|A}, you are truly deserving of becoming {appellationNew|A}.

8218002.en: You're so powerful, {name|A}! You had a breakthrough to {grade|A} just like that. Looks like I have to work hard on my cultivation too.
8218002.ch: {name|A}，好强，你这就突破到{grade|A}了，看来我也要努力修行啦。

8218101.en: You're so amazing, {name|A}! You had a breakthrough to {grade|A} just like that.

8218102.en: I brought you {0}. Hope you like it...
8218102.ch: 我给你带来了{0}，希望你会喜欢……

8218201.en: {call|B|A}, you had a breakthrough to {grade|A}. Your noble bearing is to be admired.
8218201.ch: {call|B|A}，你这便突破到了{grade|A}，君之风采，令人钦佩。

8218202.en: I brought you {0} to congratulate you on Breakthrough into a new Realm.
8218202.ch: 我给你带来了{0}，祝你突破了新的境界。

8218302.en: The monsters in the world have become more active recently. Be careful.
8218302.ch: 八荒最近的妖兽变得有些活跃，你小心一些。

8218401.en: Don't forget to have some relaxation after cultivating.
8218401.ch: 修行之余，别忘了放松一下。

8218402.en: Leniency and strictness. The way to cultivate is to occasionally stop to admire the scenery. Insight can sometimes be gained from that.
8218402.ch: 一张一弛，方为修行之道，偶尔停下来看看风景，有时也会获得感悟。

8218501.en: {call|B|A}, no matter where you go, take me with you.
8218501.ch: {call|B|A}，无论你去哪里，都记得带着我。

8218502.en: {call|B|A}, the world is big. No matter where you are, I will always think of you.
8218502.ch: {call|B|A}，八荒世界这么大，无论在哪里，我都会一直念着你。

8218601.en: {call|B|A}, you are the one I am destined to be with, and I will never forget that.
8218601.ch: {call|B|A}，你便是我命中那注定之人，一生一世都不能忘。

8218602.en: Careful, this monster is very powerful. Leave! I will deal with this vile fiend!
8218602.ch: 小心，这妖兽着实厉害，你快走，我来对付这孽畜！

8218701.en: How can I leave you by yourself...?

8218702.en: If you don't go, I will have attempted to save you for nothing!
8218702.ch: 你不走，你我二人皆要陷于此地！

8218801.en: {name|B} immediately uses Energy to send you away and charges at the huge monster alone.
8218801.ch: 只见{name|B}话音刚落，她便运转灵力将你传走，独自一人扑向巨大的妖兽。

8218901.en: You're heavily wounded. It seems this monster is powerful. Go! I'll stall it.
8218901.ch: 你怎么重伤了，看来这妖兽着实强悍，你快走，我来拖住它。

8219302.en: Careful, this monster is very powerful. I have a way to blind it temporarily, so hurry and come with me.
8219302.ch: 小心，这妖兽着实厉害，我有一法可以暂时蒙蔽它，你快跟我走。

8219502.en: You're heavily wounded. So hurry and come with me!
8219502.ch: 你怎么重伤了，快跟我走。

8219701.en: Why are you being so polite to me? Do you still not understand my heart?
8219701.ch: 为何跟我如此客气，我的心意，你还不懂吗？

8219702.en: {call|B|A}, I won't let you die. If you die, my life will be without meaning. Go, leave first. I will stall it and come look for you.
8219702.ch: {call|B|A}，我不会让你死的，若你死了，我一个人活着又有什么意思，你先走，我把它拖住后便来找你。

8219801.en: This beast sure can run. Looks like I have no choice but to let it go.
8219801.ch: 这孽畜真能跑，这次只能放过它了。

8219901.en: You and I are one. There is no need to say thank you. If you have the time, come visit me more often. I've missed you...
8219901.ch: 你我本一体，不必言谢，如果有时间，多来找找我，我一直很想你……

8220002.en: {name|B} immediately uses Energy to send you away, and charges at the enemy alone. As you leave, a huge explosion shoots right up into the clouds.
8220002.ch: {name|B}话音刚落，便运转灵力将你传走，独自一人冲向敌人，在你离开之际，一道巨大的爆炸直冲云霄。

8220202.en: {call|B|A}, there are some things I've kept hidden for a long time and I wanted to tell you in a few days, but it looks like I won't get the chance...
8220202.ch: {call|B|A}，有些话我藏在心底许久，本想过几日对你说，如今看来，是没机会了……

8220302.en: You are heavily wounded and haven't had time to finish your sentence when you are transported away by Tao. As you leave, you see {name|B} charging towards the enemy, followed by a huge explosion that reaches high into the sky.
8220302.ch: 重伤的你还未来得及把话说完，便被一道法力传送走，离开之际，你看到{name|B}冲向敌人，紧接着一道巨大的爆炸波直冲云霄。

8220502.en: {call|B|A}, if I perish, please take care of yourself...
8220502.ch: {call|B|A}，如果我不在了，你照顾好自己……

8220801.en: Whatever. I'll let you off on {name|B}'s account.
8220801.ch: 罢了，看在{name|B}的面子上，便放你一马。

8220901.en: Don't be discouraged. I believe that you will surpass me one day and become number one in the world.
8220901.ch: 不要灰心，我相信终有一日，你会超过我，成为八荒第一的存在。

8221002.en: Hmph. If {name|B} didn't come out to save you today you'd be dead. Get lost.
8221002.ch: 哼，今日若不是{name|B}出来救你，你死定了，快滚吧。

8221102.en: Don't be discouraged. I see a lot of potential in you. You are sure to be a world-dominating existence in the future.
8221102.ch: 不要灰心，你可是我看好的人，以后必定会是主宰八荒的存在。

8221301.en: You...! Whatever, I'll spare {name|A}'s life on your account.
8221301.ch: 你—！罢了，今日看在你的面子上，便饶了这{name|A}一命。

8221401.en: Do not take momentary failure to heart. Real strength is to stand up again when you have fallen. I see great potential in you, and I believe you will be able to suppress groups with your skill in the future to dominate the world.
8221401.ch: 不要将一时的失败放在心上，真正的强者是哪里跌倒就在哪里站起来，你是我看中的人，我相信你未来必定可以把技压群雄，称霸八荒。

8224002.en: You are in a hurry when you see a man being chased, and he is fleeing for his life. The man sees you and his expression changes, then he runs quickly towards you.
8224002.ch: 你正在赶路之际，突然看到前方有一男子正被人追杀，那男子看到你，神色一变，迅速向你跑来。

8224101.en: Spirit, this person wants to take my life while I'm heavily wounded and offers no explanation as to why. I cannot defeat her. Could you help me...
8224101.ch: 仙子，此人趁我重伤，不言分说便要取我性命，我打不过她，可否帮帮在下……

8224102.en: Cultivator, I have a grudge against this person to settle. I advise you not to meddle.
8224102.ch: 这位道友，我与此人有仇，劝你别多管闲事。

8224201.en: She is talking nonsense. I don't even know this person.
8224201.ch: 她胡说，我根本就不认识此人。

8224202.en: Help should be given when there is injustice.
8224202.ch: 哼，路见不平，自当出手相助。

8224302.en: T-Thank you for saving me, Spirit.

8224402.en: My name is {name|B}, and I am a Rogue Cultivator. If I had not been fortunate enough to run into you, I'm afraid I would not have survived today...
8224402.ch: 在下名为{name|B}，乃一介散修，若不是有幸遇见仙子，只怕我命不久矣……

8224701.en: You rest in the inn for a few days and are about to leave when a man comes to you asking for help.
8224701.ch: 你在客栈中休息了几日，正欲离开，却见一男子向你求救。

8224702.en: Spirit, please save me! This person wants me to be her servant, or she would kill me...
8224702.ch: 仙子，救救我，此人趁我重伤竟要对我下杀手，可否帮帮在下……

8224802.en: I cannot turn a blind eye to the bullying of the weak.
8224802.ch: 仗势欺人，欺负弱者，我岂能熟视无睹。

8224901.en: Ah, let's see if you have the capability to back your words.
8224901.ch: 哟，那就看你有没有这个本事了。

8225002.en: My name is {name|B}, and I am a Rogue Cultivator with no Sect. If it hadn't been for you, I... I wouldn't have known what to do...
8225002.ch: 在下名为{name|B}，乃一介散修，并无师门，若不是仙子为我解围，我……我真不知该怎么办。

8225102.en: I will repay you one day for your kindness. Please allow me to take my leave now.
8225102.ch: 仙子解围之恩，他日必报，容在下先行告退。

8225301.en: You have just entered the market when you hear a man shouting, "Catch the thief!" You look toward the commotion and see a woman running, with a man hot on her heels, and they are heading in your direction.
8225301.ch: 你刚进入坊市，就听到有男子大喊“抓贼”，循声望去，你看到一女一男正在前后追逐向你跑来。

8225302.en: Spirit, help me stop that thief, quick!
8225302.ch: 仙子，快帮我拦住前面那小贼。

8225602.en: Thank you for the reminder, Spirit. My name is {name|B} and I am a Rogue Cultivator. This thief stole the Interspatial Ring that holds all my possessions. If not for you stopping the thief, I... I wouldn't have known what to do.
8225602.ch: 多谢仙子提醒，在下名为{name|B}，乃一介散修，这小贼偷走的储物戒中便是我的全部财物，若不是仙子最后拦住这贼子，我……我真不知该如何是好。

8225901.en: After you defeat Hellish Dangkang, you discover a man trapped in the cave. You gather your Energy and break the seal, freeing him.
8225901.ch: 你击败异兽后，在其洞府中发现有一男子被困在此处，你凝聚灵力破开禁制，将他救了出来。

8226002.en: Do not be mistaken, Spirit. My name is {name|B} and I am a Rogue Cultivator who entered these caves by accident. If it weren't for your great feat in defeating the evil beast, I'm afraid I would have been buried here.
8226002.ch: 仙子别误会，在下名为{name|B}，乃一介散修，身受重伤后误入了此等龙潭虎穴，若不是仙子大发神威，击杀这异兽，只怕我早晚都要葬身于此。

8226302.en: {call|B|A}, since you joined a new Sect, I want to join too, so I'll work hard.
8226302.ch: {call|B|A}，你既已加入了新宗门，那我也要努力进你的宗门了。

8226501.en: {call|B|A}, we agreed to train together. I'll come to the new Sect to look for you soon.
8226501.ch: {call|B|A}，咱们可是说好要一起修行，你且等我些时日，我很快就来新宗门找你。

8227201.en: As soon as {name|B} is done speaking, magic is cast to teleport you before you can protest, and as you leave, the last thing you see is the monster pouncing at his steady form.
8227201.ch: 只见{name|B}说完，不等你开口，便施展法力将你传送走，离开之际，你看到了庞大的妖兽正扑向了他坚定的身躯。

8227502.en: {name|B} casts magic to teleport you before you can finish your sentence, and as you leave, the last thing you see is the monster pouncing at his steady form.
8227502.ch: 只见{name|B}不等你说完，便施展法力将你传送走，离开之际，你看到了庞大的妖兽正扑向了他坚定的身躯。

8228001.en: You helped me in the past, and today gave me a chance to help you back.
8228001.ch: 当初你帮了我，今日我也有机会帮回你了。

8228302.en: Cough... You don't have to worry, I'm alive.

8228402.en: Yes. I escaped with my life but I am heavily wounded. I'm afraid it will take months for me to recuperate. Are you okay?
8228402.ch: 真的，不过我虽然活着跑了出来，但也落得了重伤，恐怕需要数月来修养，你还好吗？

8228701.en: {call|B|A}, there's no need to be concerned about me if I die.
8228701.ch: {call|B|A}，如果我不幸身死，不必挂念我。

8229001.en: I'm not dead but I'm heavily wounded. I'll need at least a few months to heal. Take care of yourself. I... I'll go tend to my wounds.
8229001.ch: 虽说没死，但也重伤，少不得几个月的休养，你照顾好自己，我……我先去养伤了。

8229101.en: I envy you two, but I am too much of a coward to tell her my feelings.
8229101.ch: 真羡慕你们，我却不敢向她诉说衷情。

8229201.en: {call|B|A}, we've been together for years. Why are you suddenly leaving me...?
8229201.ch: {call|B|A}，这些时光我们都一起走过，为何突然要离开我……

8229501.en: What a coincidence to meet you here, {name|A}.

8229602.en: I hoped to meet you here, {name|A}...
8229602.ch: {name|A}，我在此地便是期待着遇到你……

8229701.en: You're here too, {name|A}. Are you buying something?
8229701.ch: {name|A}，你也来此地，可是要买些什么？

8229801.en: What a coincidence that you're here too, {name|A}.

8230202.en: {name|A}, {name|C} dared to take advantage of my unpreparedness to ambush me.

8231302.en: {name|A}, my {relation|C|B} {name|C} is in danger and I must go to the rescue. If... If fate allows, I will see you again...
8231302.ch: {name|A}，我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}遇到了危险，我必须前去相救，若……若有缘，还会再见……

8231501.en: {call|B|A}, the martial arts I am cultivating are poor and I need to cultivate a better martial art. I hope to find some that suit you in the meanwhile.
8231501.ch: {call|B|A}，如今我所修功法着实差劲，需要去寻找更好的功法才行，希望同时能给你找到合适的功法。

8231502.en: {call|B|A}, I recently found that all my martial arts have failed to keep up with the Realm. If I cannot increase my strength, how can I be qualified to stand by your side?
8231502.ch: {call|B|A}，近日发觉所修功法已逐渐跟不上境界，必须修炼更强的功法，否则又怎有资格站在你身边。

8231701.en: {call|B|A}, I have been a little lazy recently and my cultivation is increasing slowly. I will go train now, and I hope you do not rebuke me...
8231701.ch: {call|B|A},我近日有些偷懒，修为增长缓慢，我现在就去修行，希望你不会责怪我……

8232002.en: We've just met. It would be irresponsible of me if I say yes now. I think we need to get to know one another a little better first...
8232002.ch: 我们方才认识没多久，若同意了便是对你的不负责，不若我们多了解一下彼此……

8232101.en: I fell in love with you the first day we met. Now, you are willing to join me and become my Partner. I am so happy...
8232101.ch: 在你我相遇的第一天，我便倾心于你，如今你愿与我结为道侣，我很开心……

8232301.en: {call|B|A}, I had a breakthrough to {grade|B}. Though outranking you, I think you are the only one that deserves the title of the number one person in the world.
8232301.ch: {call|B|A}，我突破到{grade|B}，虽然比你高，但在我心里，你以后才配做这八荒第一人。

8233601.en: In a lower realm than me, {name|C} looks so merry in front of me. I'd give {gender2|C} a good lesson to make {gender2|C} learn.
8233601.ch: 那{name|C}境界比我低，却在我面前如此跳脱，我好好教训{gender|C}一顿，教{gender|C}长长记性。

8233701.en: {call|B|A}, I finally defeated {name|C}. Even though this person's realm exceeds mine, so what? No one can stop me from reaching greater heights.
8233701.ch: {call|B|A}，我终于把那{name|C}打败了，为求念头通达，纵然此人境界超过我又如何。

8234202.en: That {name|C} stole my item and still acts so righteous about it! How infuriating!
8234202.ch: 那{name|C}偷了我的东西还理直气壮，气死我了！

8234402.en: If you don't care about me, why should I intentionally degrade myself? I will dust off this memory and you and I will meet again as strangers.
8234402.ch: 你既对我如此不在乎，以后你我再见便是陌路。

8234901.en: {name|A}, I did not expect you to be so adept at Forging that you can produce an Artifact of this quality.
8234901.ch: {name|A}，想不到你的炼器水平如此厉害，竟能炼出此等品质的法宝。

8235301.en: {call|B|A}, that {name|C} is truly vicious to slander me. I know you won't believe that, right...?
8235301.ch: {call|B|A}，那{name|C}真是内心险恶，竟向你诋毁我，我知道你一定不会相信的，对不对……。

8235401.en: {call|B|A}, congratulations on becoming the {appellationNew|A}! Your immortal bearing is to be admired.
8235401.ch: {call|B|A}，恭喜你成为{appellationNew|A}，仙子风采，令人仰慕。

8235602.en: {call|B|A}, you've had Breakthrough to {grade|A}. I must also work harder to continue down the same path as you.
8235602.ch: {call|B|A}，你这便突破到了{grade|A}，我也要更加努力，方才有资格陪你走下去。

8235701.en: I brought you {0} to congratulate you for Breakthrough to a new Realm.
8235701.ch: 我给你带来了{0}，祝你突破了新的境界。

8236101.en: Careful, this monster is very powerful. Leave! I will stall this vile fiend!
8236101.ch: 小心，这妖兽着实厉害，你快走，我来对付这孽畜！

8236402.en: If I didn't come out... Would you have remembered me...?

8236802.en: Phew, we escaped. Be more careful the next time you fight a monster.

8237002.en: It's too bad that it got away. You'll have to be more careful next time.
8237002.ch: 可惜让它跑了，你下次可要注意点才是。

8237102.en: Why are you being so polite with me? Do you still not understand my heart?
8237102.ch: 为何跟我如此客气，我的心意，你还不懂吗？

8241401.en: Would you like a cockfighting contest with me?
8241401.ch: 要和我来一场斗鸡比试吗？

8241702.ch: （斗鸡-切磋模式好感度提升剧情）

8241802.en: Hahaha! Your chicken is now mine!
8241802.ch: 唔哈哈哈哈哈，你的鸡现在是我的啦！

8241803.en: Okay, let's have a contest then!
8241803.ch: 好的，那我们就来较量一下吧！

8241804.en: Bring it on! My Immortal Chicken is strong!
8241804.ch: 来啊，我的仙鸡可是很强的！

8241805.en: Let's have a round! I really like cockfighting too.
8241805.ch: 来一场吧！我也非常喜欢斗鸡。

8241806.en: Sorry, I have something else to do.
8241806.ch: 不好意思，我还有事在身。

8241807.en: Sorry, I don't have to have a cockfighting match now.
8241807.ch: 对不起，我现在不想进行斗鸡比试。

8241808.en: I'm not in the mood for it. Another day?
8241808.ch: 现在我全无兴致，改日吧！

9202000.en: Congratulations on the win. Here is the reward.

8241809.en: You saved me back then, and I've always remembered it...
8241809.ch: 当初你救我，我心里一直记着……

8241810.en: I thought we knew each other well, but I find that you do not seem to care much about our relationship...
8241810.ch: 我以为你我也算熟识了，却发现你似乎不是很在意你我之间的关系……

8241811.en: You seem to dislike me. Should I stop bothering you...
8241811.ch: 你似乎有些讨厌我，我是不是不该再打扰你了……

8241812.en: I was touched when you saved me back then. If you don't like me, I do not wish to bring you trouble either...
8241812.ch: 当初你救我，我心里感念，若你不喜我，我也不想给你带来烦恼……

8241813.en: I will not disturb you again, {call|B|A}. I hope you reach XII soon.
8241813.ch: {call|B|A}，我不会再打扰你了，祝你早日修成大道

8241821.en: At this moment, you moved at once and suddenly felt an extremely powerful Breath appear somewhere in Chi You. This Breath seems familiar, like you've encountered it before...
8241821.ch: 就在此刻，你心念一动，突然感受到赤幽州某处出现了一股极其强大的气息，这股气息有种似曾相识之感，就像在哪里见过……

8241822.en: May I ask if my lord is the legendary Water Deity of Nether Obscurity?
8241822.ch: 在下{name|A}，敢问阁下可是水神玄冥？

8241824.en: Not here either. It's obvious close by... Just where did that girl go...?
8241824.ch: 这里也没有，分明就在这附近啊……这孩子到底去哪里了……

8241825.en: Ah, I shouldn't have taught them the ultimate skill of hiding, which is now used against me...
8241825.ch: 唉，老夫就不该教她们那隐匿神通，结果她们倒拿来对付老夫……

8241827.en: Huh? Someone is here... You... Have you seen my daughter?
8241827.ch: 哦？有人来了……你……你见过我的女儿么？

8241829.en: Her name's Ruochuan. She is a lovely girl who looks small and delicate, with white hair and a cold aura.
8241829.ch: 她叫做若川，是一个长得小巧玲珑、一头白发、浑身散发寒气的小女孩。

8241831.en: This is... If I recall right, I met a white-haired girl while I was cultivating in Yong Ning. At that time...
8241831.ch: 这……要是没记错的话，在下于永宁州修炼之时曾遇见一名白发少女，当时……

8241832.en: Yes, yes, that's her! Ah, don't talk about it. I finally sensed my daughter's Breath that day and got her home for less than two days before she sneaked away again.
8241832.ch: 对，就是她！那天老夫好不容易感受到小女儿的气息，刚把她带回来没两天，她就又溜走了。

8241834.en: Ahem... You came this time to ask me to help you condense Heavenly Power, I presume.
8241834.ch: 咳咳……你此番来，想必是要老夫助你凝结仙力吧。

8241836.en: In that case, I'll reluctantly make a move if you can find my daughter.
8241836.ch: 既如此，若能将我的小女寻来，老夫便勉为其难出手一次。

8241837.en: This is her bracelet. You might be able to find the whereabouts of my daughter with it. She has cultivated the Ultimate Skill to avoid my detection, so if it's a Cultivator of your level, maybe you can catch hold...
8241837.ch: 这是她的手链，用此物或许可以查探小女的下落，她对老夫的感知力太过敏感，若是换做你等修仙者，或许可以得手……

8241838.en: Oh, you mean my elder daughter? That's okay... Ahem, she's all grown up and I don't have to worry about her anymore...
8241838.ch: 哦，你是说我那大女儿啊，那没事了……咳咳，她长大了，老夫可以不用担心了……

8241839.en: Argh, I'm looking for my younger daughter, not her!
8241839.ch: 唉，我要找的是我那小女儿啊，并不是大女儿！

8241840.en: I finally sensed my daughter's Breath that day and got her home for less than two days before she sneaked away again.
8241840.ch: 那天老夫好不容易感受到小女儿的气息，刚把她带回来没两天，她就又溜走了。

8241841.en: What should I do if anything happens to her...?
8241841.ch: 若是遇到什么意外，我可怎么放心得下……

8241847.en: Ah, I knew it. That girl must be hiding in some nook again...
8241847.ch: 唉，我就知道，这孩子说不定又藏到某个偏僻之地去了……

8241848.en: To avoid me, her father, she did not learn any other skill than an Ultimate Skill that hides Breath.
8241848.ch: 为了躲老夫，她别的本领没学会，倒是先练就了一身隐匿气息的神通！

8241855.en: Have you found my younger daughter?
8241855.ch: 你找到我的小女儿了么？

8241857.en: (The dying Zhujian lets out a tragic cry and limps weakly into the ice cave.)
8241857.ch: （奄奄一息的诸犍发出一声悲鸣，一瘸一拐地躲入了冰窟之内。）

8241858.en: This bad one falls sick so easily! You still haven't learned your lesson after being half-beaten to death. If my father gets drawn here, you'll have to face the consequences!
8241858.ch: 这个坏东西，一言不合就犯病！上次被人打得半死还不长点教训，若是把我爹引来，有你好果子吃！

8241860.en: I'm not very good at discipline. I hope I didn't hurt you!
8241860.ch: 小宠顽劣，我管教无方，没有伤着你吧！

8241862.en: Haven't seen you in a while. How you've grown!
8241862.ch: 许久未见，你都长成这样了~

8241863.en: Heheh, thank you for taking care of me in Yong Ning.
8241863.ch: 嘿嘿，之前永宁州一遇，多谢你的照顾。

8241864.en: I remember you were still caught and brought back by your father.
8241864.ch: 记得当时，你还是被父亲抓回去了。

8241865.en: Yes, but it's okay. I can still sneak out if I follow elder sister Bingyi! Heehee!
8241865.ch: 嗯，不过没关系，只要偷偷跟着冰夷姐姐，我就还能溜出来，嘻嘻！

8241869.en: Hmph. Don't act close to me. You made me go back on my own the last time, and I haven't forgotten about that.
8241869.ch: 哼哼，你可别套近乎，之前你分明让我自己回去，可别以为我忘了。

8241871.en: I was still caught by Father in the end, but I can still sneak out if I follow elder sister Bingyi! Hmph!
8241871.ch: 虽然最后还是被父亲抓到了，但只要偷偷跟着冰夷姐姐，我就还能溜出来，哼哼！

8241873.en: This place is very cold. You's better make your way out soon.
8241873.ch: 此地如此阴寒，你还是赶紧出去吧。

8241875.en: Huh? Oh... I see. You must have used the bracelet my father gave you to be able to find this place...
8241875.ch: 诶？……哦，我懂了，你能找到此处，肯定是用了我爹给的手链……

8241876.en: Ah, actually, elder sister Bingyi and I are water spirits of the Dark River, and there coincidentally given soul essence by the old man. That's how we went beyond the bounds of being demons.
8241876.ch: 唉，其实我与冰夷姐姐本是冥河的水灵，机缘巧合之下被老爹赋予了精魂，也就此超越了“妖”的范畴。

8241877.en: But the old man is preoccupied with his own matters, muttering things about the blending of Nether Air and Qi, laws of heaven and earth, and the fate of extinction. He's never cared for us sisters...
8241877.ch: 但是老爹他醉心于自己的事情，终日念叨着什么“冥灵二气”、“天地法则”、“灭亡宿命”，从来没有管过我姐妹二人……

8241878.en: Since childhood, it was my sister Bingyi who played with me, read stories to me, and shared a bed with me.
8241878.ch: 从小到大，都是冰夷姐姐陪我玩耍，给我讲故事，和我一起睡觉。

8241879.en: My elder sister said that Father will only worry about us if we run away from home, so she took me out into the world...
8241879.ch: 姐姐说，只有我们逃出家，老爹才会为我们担心，于是就带着我来到了八荒……

8241880.en: So are you really going to take me back...?
8241880.ch: 所以说，你真的要带我回去吗……

8241883.en: That seems about right. Let's go!

8241885.en: Don't over-think it! I'm only helping you this time because my pet Zhujian hurt someone by accident!
8241885.ch: 你别多想，我可是看在先前我小宠诸犍冒失伤人的份上，才帮你这一次！

8241886.en: I'm going back to my father's place. You should hurry over too.
8241886.ch: 我先回老爹那了，你也赶紧过来吧。

8241888.en: Fine, I'll go with you. Hmph!
8241888.ch: 行吧，那我就跟你走一趟，哼！

8241896.en: My daughters, when will you understand this old man's good intentions? *Sigh*
8241896.ch: 女儿啊，你们何时才能理解为父的良苦用心，唉……

8241897.en: Hmph, I don't care. I only listen to elder sister Bingyi.
8241897.ch: 哼，我不管，我只听冰夷姐姐的。

8241898.en: Father, since we were children, you've never cared if we sisters had full bellies. My poor little sister had something to eat for one meal, but nothing for the next. She was malnourished, and her development stunted...
8241898.ch: 爹，打小时候起，你就没管过我姐妹俩一顿饱饭。可怜我妹妹，饥一顿饱一顿，营养不良、发育迟缓……

8241900.en: That's because you ate way too much. You even ate your younger sister's food! We didn't have an excess of good things for you to destroy...
8241900.ch: 那是因为你太能吃了，妹妹的份儿你都不放过，哪有那么些好东西让你霍霍……

8241901.en: And you didn't teach us sisters any powerful techniques. We were bullied by the fish monsters...
8241901.ch: 还有，你也不教我姐妹俩厉害的法术，让我们被鱼怪欺负……

8241903.en: You have the gall to say that? You let your younger sister act all pitiful, then you stole all the Crab King fry!
8241903.ch: 你还有脸说，让妹妹卖惨装可怜，把人家珠蟞鱼一窝鱼苗全给偷了！

8241904.en: Oh, those are just things of the past. We can just not talk about them... I have come out into the world to seek something. This item is in the shape of a fish, but smells not of it, yet it is as sweet as syrup. I wonder if you are interested, daughters.
8241904.ch: 唉，过去之事，不提也罢……为父此番前来八荒山海，偶得一物。其形似鱼，却全无鱼味，反倒甘之如饴。不知女儿们可否有兴趣？

8241905.en: Wow, I didn't know that there were fish like this... It's so sweet! Thank you, Father!
8241905.ch: 哇，想不到还有长这样的鱼…好甜——谢谢爹爹！

8241906.en: Hmph. They're just red bean cakes made in the shape of a fish. Are you trying to fool a child? *grumble* (Ooh, it's really sweet.)
8241906.ch: 哼，不过是些红豆糕饼，做成鱼的形状，糊弄三岁小孩！咕哝咕哝…（哇，真的好甜）

8241909.en: Fish... Don't talk about my fish...

8241910.en: Thank you for finding my daughter! I won't make this difficult for you. As long as you pass my trial, the <r>Primordial Air - Water</r> is yours.
8241910.ch: 感谢小友帮老夫寻回女儿！我也不多为难你，你只需通过我的试炼，这<r>先天一气·水</r>便给你。

8241911.en: Yes, this is the <r>Primordial Air - Water</r>. You have to combine it internally with your Qi, then condense a bit of Immortal Power.
8241911.ch: 嗯，此乃<r>先天一气·水</r>，你将其与体内灵气融合，便可凝结一丝仙力。

8241912.en: My daughters have grown up, so they can go where they please. The desolate destiny of the world... How can it be broken...?
8241912.ch: 女儿大了，就由她们去吧，八荒山海的宿命，究竟该如何破局……

8241914.en: Oh? Do you want to exchange some blows with this old man, little friend?
8241914.ch: 哦？小友莫非还想与老夫过上两招？

8241915.en: Keep this. Remember not to bother me so much in the future...
8241915.ch: 这个你收好，以后记得少来打扰老夫……

8241916.en: You are just about to leave when you suddenly sense a village nearby that has appeared out of thin air. The village is covered in fog, hidden from sight, and seems to be hiding some secret... Did <r>Primordial Air</r> appear?
8241916.ch: 行至半路，你忽然察觉不远处凭空出现了一座村落，这村落云雾缭绕、若隐若现，似乎隐藏着什么秘密……莫非是那<r>先天一气</r>现世了？

8241918.en: The Nether Air in Chi You is running rampant. How is a village here? This place is very strange...
8241918.ch: 赤幽州内冥气肆虐，怎会有如此村落？此地着实诡异……

8241919.en: Hey! Look, everyone! Someone is coming!
8241919.ch: 诶唷，大伙儿快瞧啊，有人来了！

8241920.en: Looks like a scholar from the way he's dressed.

8241921.en: Nonsense! He's obviously a child of a rich family from the city. We'll have to greet him well.
8241921.ch: 瞎说，这分明就是城中哪个富贵人家的孩子，咱可得好生伺候着。

8241922.en: If only I also had the good fortune to stroll about the city... Ah...
8241922.ch: 咱要是有这命呐，也想去城里逛一逛，可惜……

8241923.en: Shush. Come with me to greet the guests.
8241923.ch: 诸位莫要大声喧哗，随我迎接客人。

8241925.en: You have come a long way, sir. Please rest in our small village and feel free to let me know if you need anything.
8241925.ch: 客官远道而来，还请在小村中歇歇脚，若有需要，随时吩咐小女便是。

8241926.en: This is a nameless village that is not as important as the known cities and town you pass through. I hope you do not mind our humble services.
8241926.ch: 此地乃一处无名村落，比不得客官所经之名城重镇，还望客官不必介怀。

8241927.en: I am but a simple woman. It is thanks to the people of the village that I became someone who manages an establishment. Please do forgive me if any offense is taken.
8241927.ch: 小女只是一介布衣，承蒙村里人抬举，做了个管事的，若有冲撞之处，还请客官海涵。

8241928.en: You seem to have traveled far, dear guest. You look tired and beleaguered by thoughts. Please stay and rest at my establishment for a night, and you can leave in the morning...
8241928.ch: 怕是客官旅途颠簸、身子疲乏，多有思虑。如蒙不弃，还请客官下榻于小店安眠一晚，明早再登程不迟……

8241930.en: Hey. you! Yes, you. Come help me chop this bundle of firewood.
8241930.ch: 喂，你，对，就是你，快来帮我把这捆柴禾劈了。

8241931.en: The two tubs of clothing in the yard haven't been washed yet. You'd better wash and dry them,
8241931.ch: 诶，院子里头那两缸衣服还没洗呢，你可记得洗好晾干呀。

8241932.en: Hey, do you know how to do it, or not? I taught you so many times, didn't I? You have to press the axe handle with both hands to apply force!
8241932.ch: 诶，你会不会啊！我不是教过你很多遍吗，双手虎口压住斧柄才能使上力啊！

8241933.ch: 啊啊啊！你小心点，别砍到我！

8241934.en: Observe my hands. Like this, then this, and then spread some wood ash, then rinse it a few times with water. Get it?
8241934.ch: 看着我的手，这样，再这样，然后撒点草木灰，在用水冲几遍，明白了吗？

8241935.en: Hey, what's wrong with you? Don't splash me!
8241935.ch: 诶，你怎么回事，溅我一身！

8241936.en: It's been a hard days work. Good job.
8241936.ch: 劳累了一天，真是辛苦你了。

8241938.en: It's unexpected. You look like the descendant of a noble, but you've lived here for ten years... Village life is one of hard work and frugality. You've suffered.
8241938.ch: 没想到你看着像是贵族后裔，却在此地一住就是十年……村人的生活便是这样辛劳而俭朴，让你受苦了。

8241939.en: (Ten years have passed in the blink of an eye... I feel like my mind is clouded, and I can't remember many things...)
8241939.ch: （！！一晃眼竟真的已经过去十年了么……怎么感觉头脑一阵眩晕，很多事情记不起来了……）

8241941.en: Have an early night, you hear? There might still be work for you tomorrow.
8241941.ch: 记得早歇息，明日或许还有活计要劳烦阁下。

8241942.en: Huh? Are you leaving? Alright, please come back to visit whenever you have time.
8241942.ch: 嗯？阁下要走了么？也好，若得闲暇，还请常回来看看。

8241943.en: I am honored to have you back here. Would you like to stay for a while?
8241943.ch: 阁下返回此地，小女倍感荣幸，不知阁下可愿暂住一宿？

8241944.en: Did you sleep well, {name|A}? The fruits in the backyard are probably ripe. Please pick some for me if you have time.
8241944.ch: {name|A}，昨夜睡得还好吗？后院的果子大概是熟了，若是你有闲暇，还请替我摘些下来。

8241945.en: The fruits on the ground are likely from the wind blowing them down.
8241945.ch: 地上这些果实，大概便是被狂风吹下来的吧。

8241948.en: It's fair for me to eat one first, right?

8241949.en: This doesn't seem enough. Better pick more.
8241949.ch: 好像还不够，再采一些吧。

8241954.en: There are so many people in the village. Better pick some more...
8241954.ch: 村子里那么多人呢，还是再多采一些吧……

8241959.ch: 嗯…这样应该就差不多了。

8241960.en: A good harvest. Come, everyone! Let's try the fruits {name|A} just picked.
8241960.ch: 丰收了呢，大家都来尝一尝{name|A}刚摘的果实。

8241961.en: Mm... Fresh and juicy, delicate and refreshing. This is the best thing on earth.
8241961.ch: 嗯，鲜嫩多汁、细腻爽口，实在是人间至宝。

8241963.en: Today is the twentieth year since {name|A} came to our village. It seems like it was just yesterday. Time passes so quickly...
8241963.ch: 今天是{name|A}到咱们村的第二十个年头了，一晃眼，时间过得真快……

8241965.en: Please go to bed early if you have nothing else to tend to.
8241965.ch: 没什么事的话，就请早些就寝吧，

8241968.en: Good morning, {name|A}. I've made soup for everyone today but I have to travel out of the village later, so help me keep an eye on the pot while I'm gone.
8241968.ch: 早啊，{name|A}。今天特意我为大伙儿熬了汤，可待会儿我还得出村一趟，你可记得帮我照看着锅呀。

8241970.en: So many years have passed, but everyone's tastes have not changed one bit... Brother Li likes spicy food, Sister Sun likes sweet things, Miss Nangong likes sour stuff...
8241970.ch: 都过去这么多年了，大家的口味几乎一点儿没变……李大哥喜欢辣、孙小妹喜欢吃甜的、南宫姑娘最爱吃酸味……

8241971.en: I don't know when she will be back. I can't let the soup boil dry.
8241971.ch: 不知她何时回来，我可不能让这汤烧干了。

8241972.en: This soup smells really good. I want to try it...
8241972.ch: 此汤鲜香扑鼻，我便试尝一番……

8241975.en: The soup has become thicker, but it still looks like I have to boil it for longer.
8241975.ch: 汤变得更浓了，但好像还要再煮一会儿。

8241981.en: The soup looks like it's ready, but the others are not here yet. I'll have to keep an eye on it.
8241981.ch: 汤看来是已经煮好了，但大伙还没来，我得再照看汤锅一会儿。

8241987.en: We can start eating now, {name|A}, everyone.

8241988.en: I've been smelling this aroma since early morning. It's been really difficult to hold back!
8241988.ch: 大清早就闻到这股香味，可把我憋坏了。

8241989.en: We wouldn't have this taste of joy if it weren't for the village chief's deft hands, hahaha.
8241989.ch: 要不是村长心灵手巧，咱们哪有这等口福，哈哈哈。

8241990.en: It's all thanks to {name|A}'s careful attendance, or the soup would have been burnt. Thirty years have passed in a flash. We've all become old...
8241990.ch: 这汤可多亏了{name|A}的照看，不然肯定得烧坏了。一转眼三十几年过去了，大家也都老了……

8241995.en: This is Chi You, a place where the world is surging with Nether Air. If you have no important business here, leave quickly, or your life will be lost.
8241995.ch: 此地乃赤幽州，是八荒山海中冥气肆虐之地，小友若无要事，还请速速离去，否则性命难保。

8241997.en: I am the Earth Deity, Houtu. What else do you have to say?
8241997.ch: 老身乃土神后土，你还有何话讲？

8241998.en: What persistence. I guess you've passed this tempering.
8241998.ch: 如此执念，也算得通过这番锤炼了。

8241999.en: I'll give this item to you.

8242000.en: You suddenly feel dizzy. and the space in front of you seems to start collapsing.
8242000.ch: 你突然一阵眩晕，身前的空间似乎开始分崩离析。

8242002.en: You know when to let go. Your noble character is to be admired.
8242002.ch: 懂得放下，此等格局，难得难得！

8242007.en: If there is no chance, it will be difficult to make even an inch of progress in this life.
8242007.ch: 若无机缘，怕是此生难得寸进。

8242009.en: Oh my! The sun of legends is so capable? Be good and stand still! I'll turn you into an ice sculpture!
8242009.ch: 哎哟，传说中的太阳就这点能耐？乖乖站好，让姐姐把你做成冰雕岂不美哉！

8242010.en: Hmph. Enough with the nonsense. My Yang Recharge Fire is lacking, but it's enough to turn you to vapor!
8242010.ch: 哼，少废话，我的纯阳之火再不济，也足够把你烧成水蒸气了！

8242011.en: Your manner of speaking is lofty, Miss. But I heard that a certain Three-legged Crow was nearly shot dead by mortals, and fled in distress for a long time.
8242011.ch: 姑娘家的口气不小，我可听人说，某三足乌差点被一个凡人射死，为此还狼狈逃窜了许久。

8242013.en: I also heard that a certain water spirit is greedy, and tricked her younger sister out of her rations all the time. What's worse is that she also persuaded her younger sister that it was not her, causing much sadness for their poor father's heart.
8242013.ch: 我也听人说了，某水灵贪吃成性，整日巧取豪夺妹妹的口粮，更过分的是，她还舔着脸哄骗无知妹妹，致使老父亲心力憔悴。

8242015.en: (Can't these two pick a place to fight...? Whatever, I'll just watch the show. If the two of them suffer heavy injuries, I can haul it in and kill them both. Heheh!)
8242015.ch: （这两个家伙，打架也不知道挑个地方……算了，权当看戏好了，若是她们两败俱伤，我便坐收渔翁之利，把她们都杀了，哼哼！）

8242019.en: (Damn it, it's this guy. If I'm discovered, I won't be able to go on a killing spree today...)
8242019.ch: （可恶，竟然是这家伙，若被其搅局，今日恐怕不能大开杀戒了……）

8242020.en: I vow to fight this woman today! You don't have to waste any words on convincing me otherwise!
8242020.ch: 今日我誓与此女一决雌雄，你不必多费口舌！

8242021.en: Yes, we have to fight it out. It won't work well even if Father came here.
8242021.ch: 对，我俩高低得碰一下子，我爹来了也不好使。

8242023.en: You feel the terrifying air of hatred between the two, and find yourself but a newcomer in front of them...
8242023.ch: 圣阳和冰夷释放出了强大的怨念，你感觉自己在她们的面前变得无比渺小……

8242024.en: Hey, Three-legged Chicken! How about we take out the passer-by that's in the way first?
8242024.ch: 喂，三脚鸡，先把碍事的路人干掉，如何？

8242025.en: Sure, it's a deal, Ice Stick Hag.

8242030.en: They turn their faces toward you, observing you with narrowed eyes. Perhaps they are both scheming something.
8242030.ch: 圣阳和冰夷扭过头来看向你，两双美眸微微眯起，似乎都在暗中盘算着什么。

8242032.en: Hey, Three-legged Chicken! How about we take out the passer-by that's watching first?
8242032.ch: 喂，三脚鸡，先把看热闹不嫌事大的路人干掉，如何？

8242035.en: (Hm... It's not a good time now to kill these two. Should I make a move...?)
8242035.ch: （唔……现在可是杀死这两人的绝佳时机，要出手吗……）

8242036.en: (It's not safe here. I should leave sooner rather than later!)
8242036.ch: （此地不宜久留，我还是先走为妙！）

8242039.en: You have just seated yourself in the Tavern when you hear a couple arguing at the next table.
8242039.ch: 你刚在酒馆坐下，便听到隔壁桌有一对男女正在争吵。

8242040.en: Wife, I was just a little late. Why do you have to get so mad?
8242040.ch: 夫人，我不过就是晚来了一会，何必生这么大气？

8242041.en: You know what day it is today! How could you make me wait so long?!
8242041.ch: 今天什么日子你不知道，让我在等你这么久！

8242042.en: How could I forget? But a quarter of an hour is not a long time. I waited for you for a full three hours under the hot sun the last time.
8242042.ch: 我怎会不知，可一刻钟并非很久，上次我可是在烈日下，足足等了你三个时辰。

8242043.en: That was so long ago! You're still harping on about that? How petty!
8242043.ch: 那都是多久前的事了，你居然还记着，你怎如此小心眼。

8242044.en: What? Me, petty?! If I were petty I would have thrown a tantrum like what you're doing now. I just feel that since I'd waited for so long for you in the past, you waiting this little but for me is nothing...
8242044.ch: 什么叫我小心眼？我要小心眼，当时就会跟你现在一样闹脾气了，我只是觉得，既然我都等过你那么久了，你等等我又没什么……

8242045.en: So you mean I'M petty?! So I shouldn't be here splitting hairs with you, huh?
8242045.ch: 你意思就是我小心眼，我不该在这里跟你斤斤计较是不是？

8242046.en: No... I mean we can just let this slide and let us celebrate your birthday happily.
8242046.ch: 不是……我意思是这件事我们可不可以让它过去了，好好给你过这个生日。

8242047.en: {name|B}, so this is all I mean to you? I'm so disappointed.
8242047.ch: {name|B}，原来我在你心里竟然是这样的，你太让我失望了。

8242048.en: No! I just want to ask you what it will take for you to not be mad at me anymore!
8242048.ch: 不是啊！我只想问你，到底要怎样你才能不生气？！

8242049.en: What, are you tired of me now? Can't wait to dissolve our spousal relationship to go look for another person?
8242049.ch: 怎么了，现在就对我不耐烦了？是不是巴不得跟我解除夫妻关系，然后再去找一个？

8242050.en: What nonsense are you spouting, {name|C}? I'm not that type of person!
8242050.ch: {name|C}，你这说的都是些什么胡话，我怎么会是这样的人！

8242051.en: Y-You're being mean to me?! Oh, my poor wretched life!
8242051.ch: 你，你居然敢凶我，这日子没法过了！

8242052.en: The woman runs out of the Tavern as soon as the words depart her lips, leaving the man on his own.
8242052.ch: 女子话音刚落，便跑出了酒馆，留下男子一人。

8242053.en: The man raises his wine cup and walks towards you.
8242053.ch: 男子提起酒壶，向你走了过来。

8242054.en: Cultivator, would you like a drink?

8242055.en: Even a casual encounter is one of fate. Please have a seat.
8242055.ch: 萍水相逢即是缘，道友请坐。

8242056.en: Ah, communication between men is easiest after all. I have never fathomed the heart of a woman.
8242056.ch: 唉，还是我等男人之间好沟通，女人的心我从来就不曾看明白过。

8242057.en: Cultivator, may I ask why my wife was so angry? I don't understand what she's thinking.
8242057.ch: 道友，可否冒昧问一下，为何我的夫人如此生气，我都不明白她是怎么想的。

8242058.en: Whether you understand it or not actually lies in how much effort you put into it.
8242058.ch: 明不明白，其实在于你用不用心。

8242059.en: What you say is deep, Cultivator.

8242060.en: I couldn't help overhearing your argument earlier. I believe I understand the problem. May I ask if you had also been late in the past?
8242060.ch: 方才二位争吵，在下不慎听到，大概也明白其中曲折，敢问道友，往日你是否也迟到过？

8242062.en: Then was your wife as angry at those times like she was today?
8242062.ch: 那时候的尊夫人是否如今日这般生气呢？

8242063.en: No. She only told me not to be late next time.
8242063.ch: 那倒没有，最多只是让我下次别迟到。

8242064.en: Then why do you think she was so angry this time?
8242064.ch: 那你觉得这次为何如此生气？

8242065.en: Do you mean her birthday, Cultivator? There's no need to be that angry. I wasn't even that late, so I don't feel like that's a factor.
8242065.ch: 道友是指因为生日？但没必要这般生气吧，又没迟到多久，我觉得没有什么影响啊。

8242066.en: This is where you've misunderstood. Your wife does not only care about the fact that you're late, but the underlying issue of your lateness.
8242066.ch: 这便是道友的误区所在了，尊夫人在乎的，并不是你迟到这件事，而是这件事背后的问题。

8242067.en: Could you please make it clearer for me, Cultivator...

8242068.en: Can I ask if you were late for your meetings with your wife when you first went out with each other?
8242068.ch: 敢问道友，你和尊夫人初相识的时候，相约可会迟到？

8242069.en: Oh, I wouldn't dare. I would leave a bad impression on her if I were late.
8242069.ch: 那可不敢，我要是迟到了，要给她留下不好印象的。

8242070.en: So why do you dare to be late now?

8242072.en: You should understand now. Your wife did speak much on the matter after all, and the root of the problem is that she feels you are not as attentive to her as before.
8242072.ch: 道友想必已经明白了，其实尊夫人说那么多，归根到底，是因为她觉得你对她没那么用心了

8242073.en: You are right. Come to think of it, before we became husband and wife, I made preparations for her birthday well in advance, and I was never late...
8242073.ch: 道友说得是，回想起来，以前我们还未结为夫妻时，她生日我都是早早就做了准备，更是不可能迟到……

8242074.en: That's right. I have some words for you to remember, to remind yourself occasionally.
8242074.ch: 不错，我有四个字送给道友，希望道友时不时用来提醒自己。

8242077.en: As soon as the words leave your mouth, {name|B} stands abruptly.
8242077.ch: 你的话音刚落，{name|B}便猛然站了起来。

8242078.en: Cultivator, your words today have enlightened me. I will chase after my wife and get her back. This wine is my treat.
8242078.ch: 今日道友一言，让我茅塞顿开，我这便去将夫人追回来，这酒便请道友喝了。

8242079.en: I am not so used to drinking at the same table with others. My apologies.
8242079.ch: 在下不太习惯与别人同桌饮酒，抱歉。

8242081.en: The man wanders off with his bottle of wine after speaking.
8242081.ch: 男子说完话，便晃晃悠悠地带着酒壶往外走去。

8242082.en: You have just walked into town when you see a man and woman waving at you a short distance away as they walk towards you.
8242082.ch: 你方才走进城镇，便看到一男一女在不远处一边朝你挥手，一边向你走来。

8242085.en: We've made up thanks to your guidance the other day.
8242085.ch: 我们和好了，这都要多谢前些日子道友的点拨。

8242086.en: I've met {name|A}. Thank you, Cultivator, for knocking some sense into this blockhead.
8242086.ch: 见过{name|A}道友，多谢道友让我家这榆木脑袋开了窍。

8242087.en: Yes, of course, I'm a blockhead who made his wife mad so many times.
8242087.ch: 对对对，我就是个榆木脑袋，才惹夫人生了这么多气。

8242088.en: Do not chatter endlessly in front of the Cultivator.

8242089.en: Yes, yes, you are always right, my wife!

8242090.en: It is good to see that you two have made up.
8242090.ch: 能看到两位和好如初，实在最好不过。

8242091.en: This is all thanks to you, Cultivator. This {getUnitProp|C} is a token of appreciation from us. Please do not refuse it.
8242091.ch: 这还要多谢道友，这{getUnitProp|C}是我夫妻二人的一点心意，望道友不要拒绝。

8242092.en: Yes, please do not refuse, or my wife will scold me again.
8242092.ch: 是啊，道友可别拒绝，不然夫人就要说我了。

8242093.en: Hehe, in that case, I'll accept.
8242093.ch: 呵呵，既如此，我便收下了。

8242094.en: The bright moon hangs in the sky, the color of water. You see a woman in the distance walking slowly towards the lake.
8242094.ch: 明月当空，月色如水，你看到远处有一女子正缓缓走向湖中。

8242095.en: The bright moon hangs in the sky, the color of water. You see a man in the distance walking slowly towards the lake.
8242095.ch: 明月当空，月色如水，你看到远处有一男子正缓缓走向湖中。

8242096.en: That person is not seeking death, I hope?
8242096.ch: 此人难不成是在寻死，你决定？

8242097.en: Miss, do not do anything foolish.

8242098.en: Cultivator, do not do anything foolish.

8242099.en: When the woman hears your voice, she suddenly shivers, then turns around slowly. On her beautiful face flows two tracks of tears.
8242099.ch: 那女子听到你的声音后，突然浑身一颤，随后缓缓转过了身，只见她秀丽的容颜上，流下了两行清泪。

8242100.en: When the man hears your voice, he suddenly shivers, then turns around slowly.
8242100.ch: 那男子听到你的声音后，突然浑身一颤，随后缓缓转过了身。

8242102.en: It's you, {name|B}? What are you doing?

8242103.en: Nothing... You can just go. I didn't expect to be able to see you again. I have no regrets now.
8242103.ch: 没什么……你快走吧，没想到还能够再见你一面，我也没遗憾了。

8242104.en: What do you mean no regrets? What's with you?
8242104.ch: 什么叫没遗憾了，你这是何意？

8242105.en: Don't ask. We do not have a relationship anymore. I don't need your concern...
8242105.ch: 你不要再问，我们已经没关系了，我不需要你的关心……

8242106.en: {name|B}... Whatever it is, please don't do anything foolish.
8242106.ch: {name|B}……无论怎么样，你都不要做傻事。

8242107.en: {name|A}, this is not a foolish thing to me. It is a type of release.
8242107.ch: {name|A}，这对我来说，并不是什么傻事，而是一种解脱。

8242108.en: Do you know how I've been living after we separated?
8242108.ch: 和你分开后这些日子，你知道我是怎么过的吗？

8242110.en: Forget it. Our relationship has changed long ago. What's the point in talking to you about it?
8242110.ch: 罢了，你我早已不复曾经的关系，和你说那些干甚。

8242111.en: After so long, {gender|B} still can't let it go...
8242111.ch: 过了这么久{gender|B}还是没能放下……

8242112.en: {name|B}, if you won't give up on this dangerous idea today, I will stay here and stand guard.
8242112.ch: {name|B}，如果你今日不肯放弃这个危险的念头，我便一直守在此处。

8242113.en: Why, you...! You were the one who wanted to break off the relationship we had! Why are you trying to control my actions now?!
8242113.ch: 你！当初不是你要和我解除关系的吗，为何今日还要这般管我！

8242114.en: Why do you have to do this? Isn't the relationship between us over?
8242114.ch: 何必这样，你我不是早已没了关系吗？

8242115.en: In any case, I won't let you regard yourself so lightly like this.
8242115.ch: 无论如何，我都不会允许你这般看轻自己。

8242116.en: You're still getting mad at me at this conjuncture? How many sins did I commit in my past life to meet an enemy like you?
8242116.ch: 你便是这时候还要气我，我上辈子是造了多少孽，才遇到你这个冤家。

8242117.en: Whether I think lightly of myself or not is no business of yours.
8242117.ch: 我看不看轻自己又与你何干。

8242121.en: A-Are you just trying to make me angry?
8242121.ch: 你，你就是存心气我的吗！
